description: JavaScript functions for address autocompletion and dynamic state list fetching in an order management web application.

methods.name: getCountryList
methods.description: Fetches the list of countries via AJAX and initializes autocomplete.

methods.name: callCountryAutocompleter
methods.description: Sets up autocomplete for country selection.

methods.name: setKeyAsParameterAndGetStateList
methods.description: Stores selected country and triggers fetching of associated states.

methods.name: getAssociatedStateListForAutoComplete
methods.description: Fetches and displays the list of states for the selected country.

methods.name: callStateAutocompleter
methods.description: Configures autocomplete for state selection and handles UI updates based on state list size.

methods.name: getAssociatedStateList
methods.description: Generic function to fetch and populate state options based on country ID.
